noun_definition: Data copy is a duplicate of an original data structure, created to allow manipulation without altering the original.
noun_functionality: The function creates a deep copy of the input data to ensure that the original data remains unchanged during transformations.

noun_definition: Copy action is the process of duplicating selected content to the clipboard for later use.
noun_functionality: The function sets up a keyboard shortcut that triggers the copy action, allowing users to copy selected content to the clipboard.

noun_definition: Sign In Hero Copy is the textual content displayed in the sign-in interface, typically including a headline and body text.
noun_functionality: The function retrieves and displays customizable headline and body text for the sign-in hero section, allowing for localization and responsive design adjustments.

noun_definition: Copy to clipboard is a functionality that allows users to duplicate text or data to the system clipboard for pasting elsewhere.
noun_functionality: The function handles the action of copying the card number (PAN) to the clipboard when the user interacts with the corresponding UI element.
